items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: I’m trying to remember — the bass player with Brubeck, Eugene Wright.

ctx.x: I remember a story from Norman Simmons talking about hearing Duke’s music and the bass coming through those big Zenith speakers and he went like this, and it obviously made an impression on him.
Yeah. Well I’m trying to remember — the bass player with Brubeck, Eugene Wright.
